shared_elements: horizontal dividing bands separating stacked registers
a band of small repeating motifs (rosettes / loops) as a border
figures/creatures aligned in a row facing one direction
justification: Both surfaces organise profile creatures into horizontal registers separated by plain bands, with a row of small repeating motifs acting as an upper border, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a long, shallowly and precisely carved wall of repeating human processional figures with fine detail, while B is a single upright block bearing a few boldly modelled, rounded animal forms with almost no interior detail.
